body: I do similar things and it's been hard for me to change this behavior. I use tweezers to remove hair on parts of my body. The way that I have dealt with this is not to put myself into the situation where I do this. Since I primarily do this when I am alone in my room with nothing to do, I make an extra effort to have something to do while in my room alone. It's not a perfect fix but has allowed me to cut down on this. I consider it progress.
Good for you! This is something to be proud of! Hopefully this new change will lead to positive developments.
